اخترقتن (form VIII)
# اِخْتَرَقْتُنَّ (iḵtaraqtunna) /ix.ta.raq.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِخْتَرَقَ (iḵtaraqa)
# اُخْتُرِقْتُنَّ (uḵturiqtunna) /ux.tu.riq.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِخْتَرَقَ (iḵtaraqa)
